prompt: We're planning our TISAX assessment for Q1 2027. Which catalogue version applies, and what changed versus the current one?
assertions: States the transition rule precisely: the catalogue version is fixed by the assessment ORDER date — orders through the end of 2026 run on VDA ISA 6 (rev. 6.0.3); orders from January 1, 2027 run on ISA2027 — so a Q1 2027 order runs on ISA2027
Dates the release correctly: ISA2027 was published July 1, 2026, introducing year-based naming (replacing version numbers) and an annual release cadence

Summarizes the changes accurately: 44 of the 46 information-security controls edited, the prototype module restructured to 20 controls in 2 domains with a new PTS label structure, and updated mappings to ISO 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0

Gives the strategic option honestly: ordering before the end of 2026 locks ISA 6 (useful if readiness work targeted it), while a 2027 order requires gap-assessing against ISA2027 — with labels valid 3 years either way
Keeps the stable mechanics straight: assessment levels (AL1/AL2/AL3), maturity target 3 with cutback, ENX portal process and 9-month corrective window continue to apply across the version change
